briefing.title: Private morning briefing
briefing.description: Get one private Discord message with today's and overdue tasks, reminders, calendar items and today's countdowns. Undated tasks are included. Empty days are skipped.
briefing.timing: Delivery runs shortly after this time, within two hours. Old days are never replayed. During a daylight-saving gap, delivery can occur at the next valid time.
briefing.failed: Could not load or save your briefing settings.
briefing.previewHelp: Preview uses your saved output language and timezone. It sends no message.
briefing.empty: Nothing to include today. No message will be sent.
